outcome: histopathological changes in placenta tissue (decreased villous tree, villous congestion, fibrin deposition in decidua)
cohort: The study included 28 pregnant women whose placenta tissues were analyzed.
finding: CTLA-4 immunoreactivity in decidua cells and stem villi decreased, and histopathological changes such as a decreased villous tree, villous congestion, and fibrin deposition in the decidua were observed in smoking, preeclampsia, and preeclampsia + smoking groups compared to controls.
